title: In vitro expansion of Wilms’ tumor protein 1 epitope-specific primary T cells from healthy human peripheral blood mononuclear cells
protocol: Thaw mature IL-4 DCs if they are cryopreserved.
Transfer mature IL-4 DCs into warm DC medium pre-warmed at 37°C.
Wash mature IL-4 DCs by centrifuging at 480 × g for 5 min and resuspend in serum-free RPMI.
Adjust cell density to 2.0 × 10^6 cells/mL in serum-free RPMI.
Add 10 μg of WT137-45 peptide per mL to the mature IL-4 DCs and incubate tubes on a roller for 1 h at 37°C.
Centrifuge the tubes at 480 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C, discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 4 mL of T-cell medium.
Count viable cells and adjust concentration to 0.5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Thaw cryopreserved autologous CD8+ T-cells.
Transfer thawed autologous CD8+ T-cells into T-cell medium pre-warmed at 37°C.
Wash and resuspend naïve CD8+ T-cells in T-cell medium to a concentration of 5.0 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Let the cells rest for 1 h at 37°C; then measure viability.
Transfer 1 mL/well of the CD8+ T-cell suspension (i.e., 5.0 × 10^6 cells) into a 24-well plate.
Transfer 1 mL of the PP DC suspension (0.5 × 10^6 cells/mL) to each well containing autologous CD8+ T cells.
Use NP DCs for the control condition.
Add 30 ng/mL IL-21 to the co-cultures.
Incubate the co-cultures at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 8 days.
Observe co-cultures daily for changes in color of media and cell confluence.
Passage cells based on their confluence and media color every 2–3 days until harvest at day 8.
Resuspend confluent cells by pipetting and transfer 1 mL into an empty well of a 24-well plate.
Fill up each well to 2 mL with DC:T cell medium.
Carefully remove 1 mL of medium and add 1 mL of fresh DC:T cell medium.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Harvest T cells from IVS1.
Resuspend the 1st IVS co-cultures by firmly pipetting and transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Wash wells by adding 2 mL of PBS-EDTA buffer in order to collect remaining cells.
Check under the microscope if all cells have been harvested. If not, repeat washing step.
Centrifuge at 480 × g for 5 minutes, decant wash buffer.
Resuspend cell pellet in fresh T cell medium supplemented with another 10% of hAB serum for a final concentration of hAB serum of 20%.
Count cells and assess cell viability.
Bring cells to a concentration of 5.0 × 10^6 cells/mL in T cell medium.
Transfer 2.0 × 10^6 CD8+ T cells to a non-sterile FACS tube.
Add 2 mL of FACS buffer and wash by centrifuging for 5 min at 480 × g, then discard buffer.
Centrifuge HLA-A2/WT137-45 tetramers at 17,000 × g for 5 min to remove aggregates.
Add 4 μL of HLA-A2/WT137-45 tetramers and incubate the cells for 15 min at 37°C.
Add 2 mL of FACS buffer and centrifuge at 480 × g for 5 min, then discard supernatant.
Stain cell pellet in remaining FACS buffer with antibody panel C for 30 min at 4°C.
Add 2 mL of FACS buffer and wash by centrifuging for 5 min at 480 × g, then discard buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL of FACS buffer.
Analyze samples on a FACSAria II flow cytometer.
Thaw cryopreserved PBL as described in step 2a.
Adjust the cell density to 2.5 × 10^6 cells/mL using T cell medium in a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Irradiate the autologous PBL with 35 Gy using an XRAD-320 device.
Seed 5.0 × 10^6 of irradiated cells in a 24-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Aspirate the medium to remove non-adherent cells.
Add 10 μg of WT137-45 peptide in 1 mL of serum-free RPMI to the adherent cells.
Incubate on a shaker in slow shaking motion at 37°C for 1 hour.
Add 5.0 × 10^6 CD8+ T cells to the corresponding well containing irradiated PBLs.
Add 30 ng of IL-21 per mL of media to the wells.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 7 days.
Passage co-cultures every 2–3 days as described in step 3.
On day 16, after 8 days of expansion, harvest T cells.
Stain the harvested T cells with HLA-A2/WT137-45 tetramers.
